control._why: Mirror-style: creature removal and wipes have few targets. Brings in flash threats, Cavern of Souls so creatures can't be countered, and Rest in Peace against graveyard recursion.

midrange._why: Another sweeper and a counter for green spells.

aggro._why: Flash fliers that block early and stop enter-the-battlefield value, plus a second sweeper. Cuts the slow Jace finishers and a draw spell. (added 2026-11-23 for the meta round robin)

graveyard._why: Added 2026-11-26: their best against graveyard-based aggro decks (graveyard hate, cards that stop enter triggers, cheap removal, sweepers). Flash fliers that block early and stop enter triggers, a second Rest in Peace, a second sweeper. Cuts slow card draw.
